task.description: Design comprehensive automated tests for OBS-05 dead letter queue behavior based on the implemented backend and requirement spec. Produce/adjust test spec and test cases covering: exhausted retries -> DLQ move with full context; GET /dlq auth, pagination, and filtering by instance_id and item_type; POST /dlq/:id/retry counter reset/resubmission semantics; POST /dlq/:id/discard transactional OBS-03 audit behavior; CANCELLED-instance retry conflict behavior (HTTP 409 path and discard handling); success path where retry removes item and instance resumes. Ensure tests are deterministic, aligned with existing harness conventions, and trace each acceptance criterion and edge case.
acceptance_criteria: OBS-05 acceptance criteria and edge cases are fully mapped to explicit test cases
Test specs and/or test source updates are concrete, executable, and deterministic
Coverage includes auth, pagination/filtering, retry, discard-audit transaction, and cancelled-instance edge behavior
Result clearly identifies files for TEST-RUNNER execution

result.summary: Test specs and integration test code for OBS-05 DLQ behavior are implemented with deterministic, traceable coverage for exhausted-retry persistence, GET /dlq auth+paging+filters, retry/discard auth paths, CANCELLED retry conflict discard handling, retry success semantics, and transactional discard audit rollback behavior.
